chain.label: Inadequate CRM/stall-recovery training program
chain.trigger: Aviation Charter was not training its pilots on CRM in accordance with its FAA-approved CRM training module

chain.label: Pilots' below-average flight proficiency
chain.trigger: both pilots had previously demonstrated potentially serious performance deficiencies during flight operations consistent with below-average flight proficiency

caused_by.evidence: Aviation Charter did not have adequate stall recovery guidance...and it did not have an in-range checklist

chain.label: Flight crew's ineffective CRM during approach
chain.trigger: the flight crew was not adhering to Aviation Charter's approach procedures and was not effectively applying CRM techniques during the approach segment of the flight

caused_by.evidence: Aviation Charter was not training its pilots on CRM in accordance with its FAA-approved CRM training module
both pilots had previously demonstrated potentially serious performance deficiencies during flight operations

chain.label: Airplane not configured for the approach
chain.trigger: the flight crew did not properly configure the airplane at the start of the approach (extending the landing gear or reducing power before descending from 3,500 feet)

caused_by.evidence: neither flight crewmember was monitoring the instruments

chain.label: Overshoot of final approach course
chain.trigger: the flight crew overshot the approach course almost immediately after being issued the turn...traveled for almost 1 mile north of the course

caused_by.evidence: the airplane was fast at this point in the approach, the flight crew had to lose a significant amount of airspeed and altitude in a short amount of time

chain.label: Failure to monitor decaying airspeed
chain.trigger: the flight crew failed to monitor the airplane's airspeed and allowed it to decrease to a dangerously low level...and to remain below the recommended approach airspeed for about 50 seconds

caused_by.evidence: the later stages of the approach flown by the accident flight crew were more difficult in terms of mental and physical demand and time pressure
neither flight crewmember was monitoring the instruments

chain.label: Failure to execute a go-around
chain.trigger: the inadequate airspeed or the full CDI needle deflection should have prompted the flight crew to execute a go-around; however, they failed to do so

caused_by.evidence: the flight crew failed to recognize that a stall was imminent

chain.label: Aerodynamic stall
chain.trigger: allowed the airplane to enter a stall from which they did not recover

caused_by.evidence: failure to maintain adequate airspeed, which led to an aerodynamic stall

chain.label: No recovery from stall
chain.trigger: an aerodynamic stall from which they did not recover

caused_by.evidence: a stall from which they did not recover

chain.label: Impact with terrain
chain.trigger: The airplane impacted the ground about 1.8 miles southeast of the approach end of runway 27

caused_by.evidence: crashed while the flight crew was attempting to execute the VOR approach to runway 27

chain.label: Fatal injuries to all occupants
chain.trigger: The two pilots and six passengers were killed, and the airplane was destroyed by impact forces and a postcrash fire

caused_by.evidence: The two pilots and six passengers were killed
